info.name: KaiShare API
info.description:
Backend tests for KaiShare (surplus food rescue). Run the folders in order: each request saves ids and tokens in collection variables for the next ones.

Set the environment (Local HTTP or Local HTTPS), start the API, run `npm run seed`, then Run collection.

exec: pm.test('Returns the user and an access token', () => { pm.expect(body.user.role).to.eql('donor'); pm.expect(body.accessToken.split('.')).to.have.lengthOf(3); });
pm.test('Password hash and refresh token are not in the body', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.match(/passwordHash|refreshToken/));

pm.test('Refresh token cookie is HttpOnly + SameSite=Strict', () => { const c = pm.response.headers.get('Set-Cookie'); pm.expect(c).to.include('HttpOnly'); pm.expect(c).to.include('SameSite=Strict'); });
pm.test('Field errors for each invalid field', () => pm.expect(errors).to.include.keys('name', 'email', 'password', 'role'));
pm.test('Generic message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Email or password is incorrect.'));
// Change the payload (role -> admin) but keep the old signature.

request.description: Uses the httpOnly refresh cookie set by the donor login (Postman keeps cookies between requests).

exec: pm.test('Suburb changed, role unchanged', () => { const u = pm.response.json().user; pm.expect(u.suburb).to.eql('Grey Lynn'); pm.expect(u.role).to.eql('donor'); });
pm.test('Saved as available, owned by the donor', () => { pm.expect(listing.status).to.eql('available'); pm.expect(listing.quantity).to.eql(24); });
pm.test('Location header points to the new listing', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Location')).to.eql(`/api/listings/${listing.id}`));

item.name: Update listing – pickup end in the past (400)

exec: pm.test('Donor sees the claim on their listing', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().items[0].rescuerName).to.eql('Postman Rescuer'));

item.name: Update claim – illegal jump to collected (409)

exec: pm.test('65-byte P-256 key in base64url (87 chars)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().publicKey).to.match(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{87}$/));
pm.test('Server encrypted and attempted delivery', () => pm.expect(r.sent + r.failed + r.removed).to.be.at.least(1));
// The Postman endpoint is not a real browser, so FCM rejects it and the server removes it (expired-subscription handling).
